reviews.title: Good keyboard!
reviews.comment: Great keyboard for the price. I love the blue LED backlighting. My first one lasted years but got dirty so I bought another one.
reviews.author: PM Lamont

reviews.title: Great value!
reviews.comment: No doubt this is actually a new unused product.  Very solid with great key feel.
reviews.author: David C McKinnon

reviews.title: Blue lights are cool
reviews.comment: Great keyboard for the price, i purchased this for work, it’s light weight, looks cool,sometimes the buttons don’t register what you click and some feel loose. All around fine quality for the cost.
reviews.author: John Kobylarz

reviews.title: Pretty durable
reviews.comment: Steelseries makes good stuff. The WASD keys were going out on my previous but they held up for about 1-2 years at least.
reviews.author: Bryan Costello
